newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida confirmed that the Commission had sent a letter to Spanish telecoms company Telefonica asking it to tell Antena 3 and Audiovisual Sport shareholders that an alliance between the three companies had been challenged by CanalSatelite. He described the Commission's letter as a precautionary measure rather than a decision. He said the Commission had received two complaints from CanalSatelite and gave Telefonica until August 18 to respond to one of them and September 1 to respond to the other.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/754: Italy: the Commission supports the fight against drought in less developed regions.
- IP/97/757: Commission clears Sega's new licensing agreements
- Eurostat news release 58/97: EU GDP up 0.1 percent in first quarter of 1997
- Eurostat Statistics in Focus: Economy and finance 1997/27: Quarterly national accounts - first quarter 1997.
